description_en: Adds IP addresses to an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 为DDoS原生防护实例添加防护对象IP
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp add-ip --ip-list ip_:_121.41.XX.XX_,_ip_:_121.42.XX.XX --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-npk1z7t90000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddIp

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses to add to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance for protection. The value is a string that is converted from a JSON array. Each element in the JSON array is a struct that contains the following fields:

ip: The IP address to add. This parameter is of the String type and is required.

member_uid: The ID of the member account that owns the asset. This parameter is of the String type and is optional. Specify this parameter only when you add an asset that belongs to a member account. For example: [{"ip":"121.41.XX.XX","member_uid":"120100811162\\"}]
parameters.help_zh:
要添加到原生防护实例进行防护的IP地址列表。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：

ip：String类型 | 必选 | 要添加的IP地址。

member_uid：String类型 | 可选 | 资产所属的成员账号，仅当添加成员账号下的资产时需要输入本字段。例如：[{\"ip\":\"121.41.XX.XX\",\"member_uid\":\"120100811162****\"}]
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to manage.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的原生防护实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有原生防护实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query information about all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance is added to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id
